posts.text:
Trump tried to bully Iran into submission and was humiliated. So he did what every bully does — salvage his ego by picking on the kid he thought was least likely to fight back.

Meanwhile, the world is learning that the best way to handle a bully is to punch him in the mouth.
posts.summary: Criticizes Trump's Iran policy as bullying, praises Iranian retaliation
